# Soak USA — Full LLM Content Index

## Identity and Scope

- Domain: https://soakusa.net
- Type: authority-first hot-spring research and safety publication
- Public location records: 0
- Live conditions: not provided
- Medical advice: not provided
- Advertising and third-party analytics: disabled

## Catalog Quality Reset

The legacy 359-record catalog is not part of the public product. It was withdrawn after a data-quality audit found material state-assignment and thermal-feature classification errors. Retired browse, state, and location URLs return a 404 response with catalog-reset guidance. The runtime contains no public location corpus.

Future location publication requires an authoritative HTTPS URL, publisher, title, human review date, supported-claim mapping, visible citation, and explicit classification as a managed facility, permitted natural soaking area, observation-only feature, or prohibited area.

## Primary Safety Rule

Use the responsible operator, park, land manager, tribe, or local authority for current permission, closures, access, fees, hazards, and emergency information. General guidance cannot establish whether a specific thermal feature is legal or safe to enter.
